name: DayNightMenuSwitch
job: A two-state toggle for lunch and dinner (or day and evening) offerings where the scene behind it shifts from sunlit to lamp-lit as the menu swaps
visitor_action: click/tap the toggle or press Space; swipe on touch
owner_settings: Two menus (title, hours, note, dishes with name, description and price)
mobile: toggle on top, menu below, swipe switches
motion: sun and moon pass each other, background crossfades, items slide (reduced-motion: instant swap)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Golden hour to candlelight: apricot and cream day scene, aubergine and amber evening scene, soft gradient sky and glow
notes: 2026-11-24: broken-fix pass. Night state: .groundNight / .hillsNight (opacity 0, declared later) were overriding .fadeIn on equal specificity, so the cream panel and day hills never faded out while the text turned cream. Added .groundNight.fadeIn / .hillsNight.fadeIn; the night panel is now aubergine with light text and the hours/note tag sits on dark hill (readable). Day state unchanged. Checked headless day + night at 1280 / 375 / worst. Known: in the worst-case night frame a very long first dish can run under the moon (day equivalent not changed). 2026-11-23: panel geometry fix (Guy review). Panel top-left radius is now 1.75x the card radius (49px circle, was a 70%/55% sweep); wide: panel left edge = end of the title column so the list sits one 48px gutter inside it, and the panel top is measured from the tallest list (64px lead) so the first row clears the curve, worst case included; mobile: same 49px circular corners. groundNight.fadeIn / hillsNight.fadeIn untouched. Known: worst-case mobile, a 4-line title still runs past the fixed 324px panel top (pre-existing).
